overview.brief: Wooded low-level region outside Qeynos; western Antonica crossroads to Surefall Glade, Blackburrow, and West Karana. Wildlife, undead, and gnolls; fisherman Hadden at the northwest pond. EQ Legends Tools recommends 1–7.
